title: cross-review `concepts/sentientism` in light of `concepts/no-self-objection-to-phenomenal-value` — §"Interests Require a Subject" (L52–60) rests moral standing on "an experiencer for whom the trajectory is good or bad" without saying *which* subject it needs, the statement the new concept's §implications says every mattering-to theory owes; the concept lists sentientism in its `concepts:` and sentientism greps 0 for it
